# Gog

## Overview

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Gog is a china dog with a gleaming coat of white and green. The figure is positioned so that it looks to the right.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055), [v4 CHAPTER 29 GILBERT AND ANNE DISAGREE P1](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0001)_

## History

Gog was a statue who formerly presided over the hearth at Patty's Place with dignity and aplomb alongside [Magog](../character/magog.md).

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P2](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0002)_
